messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Service and Subscription Management" as it appears in the following examples.
['Our record indicates that you recently made a request to terminate your www.cornell.edu email.', 'Our Support Plus plan complements and enhances your existing broadband connection with additional support and security.', 'The Classic version of AOL Mail will be replaced by our new version on 15th 20th February 2014.', 'Please reconfirm your request by choosing either of the two options below but please note that if you fail to click on option1 we will have no other choice than to delete your email box.', 'If this sign up was made by the mistake, and you want to cancel the subscription, click the link under the subscription information in this letter, and then change the password on your account, supposedly it was stolen.', "From 17 June this year, you'll need to log in to your email account at least once every 150 days."]

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}

message.content: {"summary":"We manage email and broadband services through subscription changes, cancellation requests, account access requirements, and updates to available plans and platforms."}
